_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kai dan wasa {player_id} ne a cikin Tic Tac Toe na 'yan wasa uku.
Alamar ka ita ce '{symbol}'.
Kuna juyawa wajen sanya alamar ka a kan allo na 5x5 don kirkirar layi na huɗu.
Layin na iya zama a tsaye, a kwance, ko a diagonal.
Gabatar da motsi ka ne da tsarin '[4]' don alama sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsawa mara inganci. Yi amfani da "[cell]" inda tantanin halitta shine 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lambar tantanin halitta mara inganci: {cell}. Dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} an riga an shagaltar da shi.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya yi wani motsi mara inganci

game_action.placed: Mai kunnawa {player_id} yana sanya alamar su ({symbol}) a cikin filin ({row}, {col}).
